summary: Enhance your NGO's financial management with our QuickBooks training course. Learn essential accounting skills tailored for non-profits and boost your impact.
lede: NGO accounting organizes and reports nonprofit funds, grants, and programme spending so finance teams can track restrictions and explain financial activity. For NGO finance staff and accountants, this course applies fund accounting in QuickBooks to configure accounts, code restricted grant income, allocate shared costs, reconcile accounts, monitor budgets, and prepare donor and management reports with supporting control evidence.
audienceIntro: This NGO accounting course suits professionals who already handle financial transactions, budgets, grants, or programme expenditure and now need stronger QuickBooks-based control and reporting capability. It is appropriate for intermediate to advanced learners who can connect accounting entries with donor restrictions and operational decisions.
modules: NGO Accounting Foundations and Fund Structures
QuickBooks Chart of Accounts and Data Setup
NGO Accounting Integration and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with bookkeeping, general ledger entries, budgets, grants, or programme finance. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic accounting concepts such as debits, credits, accruals, reconciliations, and financial statements is expected. No programming is required, and you do not need to bring a live QuickBooks company file. Advanced topics such as automation review and AI-assisted transaction categorization are taught at operational application and governance awareness levels, not software engineering level.
